question: How is Priscilla's resistance to tickling?
answer: She's overpoweringly resistant. Her cold stare at the one tickling her. Unable to withstand her look, and the unavoidable "Death" that will likely arrive the moment they give up tickling. The intense regret of wondering "Why did I try this?". To father, to mother, to all the children, thank you. (note: the last line there may be an Evangelion reference.)
